name: example
pageName: Your Facebook Page Name (must match exactly)

_comments.composerUrl: OPTIONAL but strongly recommended for multi-account setups. Pins the composer to a specific business + page. To get your IDs: open Meta Business Suite, navigate to the composer (Create > Post), and copy the asset_id and business_id from the URL. If you only use one Meta business, you can omit this and the tool will use the default composer URL.
_comments.carouselsRoot: Path to your content folder, relative to the meta-scheduler project root.
_comments.imagesSubpath: Pattern with {day} placeholder for image folder.
_comments.captionSubpath: Pattern with {day} placeholder for caption file.
_comments.captionStartLine: Line number in your caption file where the actual post copy begins. Lines before this are skipped (useful for files with headers). Reading stops at the first '---' line.
